  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Introduces Manski's (2015) three-element typology of data uncertainty — transitory statistical, permanent statistical, and conceptual — breaks conceptual uncertainty into sub-elements, proposes a Bayesian/BMA route to an integrated measure of total uncertainty, and notes transitory uncertainty is measurable from real-time (vintage) revision data."
  },

    {"id": "c_admin", "name": "administrative data", "aliases": [], "description": "Data whose sources of uncertainty are many and diverse and may not include sampling variation.", "anchor": "administrative data are many and diverse", "location": "mazzi-2021-measuring-communicating-uncertainty-official-economic-statistics#c0010"},
    {"id": "c_trans", "name": "Transitory statistical uncertainty", "aliases": ["transitory uncertainty"], "description": "Uncertainty stemming from early data releases that are revised as new information arrives.", "anchor": "Transitory statistical uncertainty stems", "location": "mazzi-2021-measuring-communicating-uncertainty-official-economic-statistics#c0010"},
    {"id": "c_perm", "name": "Permanent statistical uncertainty", "aliases": ["permanent uncertainty"], "description": "Uncertainty from data incompleteness or inadequate data collection that does not diminish over time.", "anchor": "Permanent statistical uncertainty arises", "location": "mazzi-2021-measuring-communicating-uncertainty-official-economic-statistics#c0010"},
    {"id": "c_conc", "name": "Conceptual uncertainty", "aliases": ["conceptual uncertainty"], "description": "Uncertainty arising from lack of understanding about what the statistics measure, i.e. from how they are interpreted.", "anchor": "Conceptual uncertainty arises from a lack", "location": "mazzi-2021-measuring-communicating-uncertainty-official-economic-statistics#c0010"},
    {"id": "c_total", "name": "total uncertainty", "aliases": [], "description": "The integrated quantity that a Bayesian approach could provide, integrating out sampling/nonsampling and transitory/permanent uncertainty.", "anchor": "integrated measure of total uncertainty", "location": "mazzi-2021-measuring-communicating-uncertainty-official-economic-statistics#c0010"},
    {"id": "c_model", "name": "Model uncertainty", "aliases": ["model uncertainty"], "description": "Uncertainty over the set of models, incorporated into Bayes' theorem by treating the model set as an additional parameter.", "anchor": "Model uncertainty is incorporated", "location": "mazzi-2021-measuring-communicating-uncertainty-official-economic-statistics#c0010"},
